scope: Prevent reopening the gain preview from launching another source scan while a closed dialog’s worker is still finishing.
behavior: Preview remains disabled until all workers detached from the closed dialog have physically stopped. No new captions or public signatures.
limits: 4 GiB memory, zero swap and CPU0 affinity verified; systemd CPUQuota=100% requested.
scientific_limit: Known-exposure paired-session acceptance remains unproven; this lifecycle correction does not close F580.
